generalFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
generalFaq.descriptionFour: We are always in touch and will respond as quickly as possible.

questionOne.title: How much does a system cost to build?
questionOne.answer: Pricing follows scope. A focused decision system for a single offer — validating a thesis or launching a product — starts at $1000. A structured multi-surface system for a company with services and case logic starts at $3000. A full commerce engine with catalog, payments and lifecycle flows starts at $5000. Every engagement is scoped against your business model and the decision flow we need to produce, so the system earns back what it costs.

questionTwo.title: How long does a build take?
questionTwo.answer: Timelines follow scope. A focused single-offer system usually ships in 7–14 days. A multi-surface company system lands in 2 to 4 weeks. A full commerce or marketplace engine with integrations runs 4 to 8 weeks. Every engagement has a fixed timeline in the signed contract and a weekly update on progress.

questionThree.title: Do you work under a contract and with prepayment?
questionThree.answer: Yes. Every engagement runs under a signed contract that fixes scope, timeline and price. Prepayment is 50% of the total engagement value. The balance is paid on delivery and acceptance. Payments accepted to FOP, cryptocurrency or Paypal — whichever fits your finance setup.

questionFour.title: What is included in an engagement?
questionFour.answer: Each engagement covers: market and competitor analysis, decision-flow and system architecture, design of every surface, build and integrations, analytics instrumentation, SEO foundation, QA and launch. You also get onboarding materials to operate the system and a 1-year product warranty.

questionFive.title: Can I run the system myself after launch?
questionFive.answer: Yes. After launch you get full access to the admin layer (where the project includes one) and onboarding for your team. You can also route changes through us and we ship them fast — no managers, no approval layers, no bureaucracy.

questionSix.title: Do you support systems after launch?
questionSix.answer: Yes. Every engagement includes a 1-year product warranty and ongoing support. That covers fixes, technical questions, advisory calls and prompt iteration on anything the data says should change.

faq.title: FAQ about Engagements
faq.description: Answers to common questions about our engagement formats, process and pricing.

questionOne.title: Can I get a system with fully custom design?
questionOne.answer: Yes. Every system gets a custom design mapped to your business model and decision flow — no templates.

questionTwo.title: Do you build for search engines (SEO)?
questionTwo.answer: Yes. Every system ships with the SEO foundation — speed, schema, architecture and mobile parity — wired in from day one.

questionThree.title: Do you design for mobile devices?
questionThree.answer: Yes. Every surface adapts to phones and tablets so the decision flow holds on any device your buyers use.

questionFour.title: What do you use to build the systems?
questionFour.answer: We pick the stack that fits your system — modern, owned, stable and proven at the scale you're targeting for the next 3–5 years.

questionFive.title: Can the commerce engine accept payments?
questionFive.answer: Yes. We integrate every major payment provider — LiqPay, PayPal, Stripe, Privat24 and any other your finance stack requires.

questionSix.title: Can new features be added after launch?
questionSix.answer: Yes. Every system is built modular — add new surfaces, features or third-party integrations any time after launch without a rebuild.

questionSeven.title: Do you build multilingual systems?
questionSeven.answer: Yes. Systems ship in Ukrainian, Russian and English, with full search architecture configured for each language.

questionEight.title: How is the system handed over?
questionEight.answer: On completion you receive full source, hosting access, admin panel and documentation — the system is yours to operate and extend.

questionNine.title: Can I get ongoing system support?
questionNine.answer: Yes. Support packages cover content operations, technical support, SEO tuning and security monitoring on an ongoing basis.

policyPage.title: Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy Code-site.art

1. General Provisions
1.1. This Privacy Policy defines the procedure for processing personal data of users of the code-site.art website.

2. Collection of Personal Data

2.2. Personal data is collected when filling out forms on the site.

3. Use of Personal Data
3.1. Personal data is used exclusively for:
- communication with clients;
- provision of services;
- sending important messages.

4. Protection of Personal Data
4.1. We take measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access.
4.2. Personal data is not transferred to third parties without the user's consent.

5. User Rights

5.2. The user has the right to demand deletion of their personal data.

6. Contact Information
